svg.title: Sablerite
svg.desc: \ ˈsā-bəl-ˌrīt \ noun. 1. A dark crystal that grows slowly, one facet at a time. Found in Rust and C++, in microcontroller firmware, and in the occasional captive portal. 2. A handle on the internet. Builds things mostly to find out how they work.

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Palatino,'Book Antiqua',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: Fig. 1. The specimen, turning slowly in the light.
